'''Kyle Schliesman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 I-10 Cup (November)]] in November 2001 with [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|New Light Objective]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3493">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-tr], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 11 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
